## Context
Story: eaf1-2378-bccc-43d3 — documentation update to reflect ci-pr mode and dual-marker semantics from this epic

## Goal
Three doc updates: (1) audit CLAUDE.md rule 24 against final S2 implementation, (2) update debug-everything quick-reference docs, (3) add KNOWN-ISSUES.md entries.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE (doc-only — no RED marker needed)

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| CLAUDE.md | modify | n/a | still-valid |
| .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md | modify | n/a | still-valid |
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | modify (header/ref) | n/a | still-valid |

## Implementation Steps
1. Audit CLAUDE.md rule 24:
   - Compare rule 24 text against final S2 implementation (check-session-merge-only.sh)
   - Confirm: .debug-active mentioned, DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 documented, AND-escape semantics for dual-marker state
   - Update if stale (S2's T3 task may have already done this — verify first)

2. Update debug-everything SKILL.md usage/quick-ref section:
   - Add ci-pr mode to the Usage block: '/dso:debug-everything (merge.strategy=pr) — ci-pr mode, per-sub-branch reviewed batches'
   - Mention .debug-active marker creation and draft PR

3. Update KNOWN-ISSUES.md with any patterns from this epic:
   - Known: closed-bug-trailer race (from S9) — add entry if not already present
   - Known: .debug-active stale marker after SIGKILL (24h TTL cleanup) — add entry
   - Known: DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING parser must use exact-prefix match (see S7) — add entry

## Acceptance Criteria
- CLAUDE.md rule 24 references .debug-active, DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0, AND-escape semantics
- KNOWN-ISSUES.md has ≥1 new entry from this epic's implementation patterns
- debug-everything SKILL.md usage section reflects ci-pr mode
- No new bugs introduced
- ruff checks pass
